page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-48-lssd is a compute-optimized server instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 180 GB of RAM, translating to 3.75 GB of memory per core. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor built on the x86_64 architecture, the system utilizes 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled to deliver 2 threads per core. The processor operates at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz and is equipped with a 504 MB L3 cache. This instance includes 2951 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 8 drives, but does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong performance characteristics across multiple domains. In single-threaded tasks, the instance achieves top-tier results, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2309.0 and high-speed single-threaded compression and decompression rates, such as 37.09 GB/sec in gzip. Multi-threaded capabilities are also robust, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 19360.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 70646.91. Memory subsystem performance is highlighted by a strong read-only small block cached bandwidth of 3861.88 GB/sec, though large block uncached read and write operations fall into the average category. The CPU's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), support accelerated matrix and vector operations.

The inclusion of 2951 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage combined with strong database operation benchmarks (23020.87 on Passmark) and high Redis throughput (89.08 million SET operations per second) makes this instance highly suitable for database hosting and high-throughput transactional workloads. It also performs well in software compilation, image processing, and low-latency web serving. For machine learning, the hardware delivers strong performance in CPU-based LLM inference, achieving 345.79 tokens per second for small model text generation, though performance drops to an average of 3.11 tokens per second for large 70B models. This resource density offers a balanced cost-to-performance profile for compute-heavy and storage-intensive workloads that do not require dedicated GPU hardware.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-48-lssd is a compute-optimized server configured with 48 vCPUs, 180 GB of RAM, and 2951 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 24 physical cores, a 2.3 GHz clock speed, and a 504 MB L3 cache. The architecture supports advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX). Benchmarks indicate top-tier single-core performance, strong multi-core capabilities, and high memory bandwidth for cached small blocks. The instance excels in database operations, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference, particularly for smaller models. With its high-speed local storage and dedicated CPU allocation, it is well-suited for high-throughput transactional databases, web serving, and data processing workloads that require fast local disk access without the need for discrete GPU acceleration.
